blocks.text: A Municipal Health Office ambulance driver and former firefighter was arrested in a late-night buy-bust operation against illegal drugs that the police conducted in Albuquerque, Bohol on Saturday, November 7. Authorities identified the suspect as Erwin Cruspero, 28, a resident of Purok 7, Upper Tagbuane, also in Alburquerque. The operation took place in the next barangay, Santa Filomena. Law enforcers described Cruspero, who was employed at the Alburquerque Rural Health Unit (RHU), as a high-value individual (HVI) in the regional illegal drug trade.
